title: Java Errors and Compiler Diagnostics
learningObjectives: Classify syntax, compile-time, runtime and logic errors

understand.concept: A syntax or type error prevents compilation; a runtime exception interrupts execution; a logic error produces an incorrect result. Read the first useful compiler diagnostic, inspect its source location and nearby code, make one correction, then compile again.
understand.whyItMatters: Java Errors and Compiler Diagnostics helps learners create Java applications that are easier to reason about, test and maintain. It connects core language knowledge with realistic programming tasks.
understand.analogy: Treat this concept as a clearly labeled tool: select it for a specific responsibility and check the result.
understand.analogyLimit: This analogy is only a learning aid; actual behavior is defined by Java language rules and API contracts.

explain.narrative:
## Java Errors and Compiler Diagnostics

A syntax or type error prevents compilation; a runtime exception interrupts execution; a logic error produces an incorrect result. Read the first useful compiler diagnostic, inspect its source location and nearby code, make one correction, then compile again.

## Applying the concept

Identify the input and desired result. Select the Java construct or API that directly supports the requirement. Keep code readable, handle documented failure cases and state assumptions clearly.

## Verification checklist

- Compile with JDK 21.
- Predict the output before running.
- Test normal, boundary and invalid inputs where relevant.
- Check resource cleanup and error handling.
- Prefer explicit types and focused methods.
